question: Which moon arts are named in this part of the enumeration?
premises: The moon arts are being enumerated.
The list continues in the next verse.
inference: The named moon arts include Śuddhi, Saumyā, Marīci, Śailajā, and Aṃśumālinī.
plain_english: Śuddhi, Saumyā, Marīci, Śailajā, and Aṃśumālinī.
